affordance_manifest.success: `1 <= n <= items.length` → sets `items[n-1].done = true`, saves, prints `Done: "N) <text>"` to stdout, exit 0; re-running on an already-done item is idempotent (same message, exit 0)
affordance_manifest.error: missing `<n>` → `E_MISSING_INDEX` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched; non-integer `<n>` (`abc`, `2.5`, `3abc`, `""`) → `E_INVALID_INDEX` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched (never bare `Number()`/`parseInt()`); out-of-range integer (`< 1` or `> items.length`) → `E_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE` to stderr, exit 1, store untouched; corrupted store → corrupted-store message to stderr, exit 1, store untouched
affordance_manifest.empty: `done 1` against a 0-item store → `E_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE` (range `[1, 0]` is never satisfiable)
